stages.prepare: identity/tracer checks, token publication, unique offsets and split indices
stages.mincore_scan: split into runs, allocate residency vectors, mincore calls and build residency dictionary
stages.batch_lookup: one library call, including arguments, dispatch and kernel result copy
stages.batch_filter: returned-range views, current token/requested-offset filter and dictionary construction
stages.result_restore: array expansion and original query statistics

internal_total: From before identity check through result-stage record; final query_costs record assembly excluded.
unmeasured: Internal total minus the five nonoverlapping stages; timing bookkeeping and batch setup/check gaps.
outer_timing: Original full query call includes new record assembly; point and session timing boundaries unchanged.
prior_real_input_validation: Reused 20-query validation because result helper body is unchanged; not repeated.
next_plan: One existing 3-before/10-after private restore: verify 40 internal records and costs, contents, guest process restoration, PFN union and cleanup; not run in this stage.
